text:
Before: 2 slices of whole grain toast (~35 g each, ~70 g, ~180 kcal), 2 poached/fried eggs (~100 g, ~160 kcal; they look poached or cooked without much oil), avocado (~60 g, ~100 kcal), lemon wedge (not eaten, or only the juice used), and water.

After: the plate has only smears of avocado and a lemon rind. The eggs, toast and avocado are essentially all eaten, with perhaps ~5 g of avocado left behind.

Eaten: toast 70 g and 180 kcal; eggs 100 g and 150 kcal; avocado 55 g and 90 kcal. The total is about 225 g and 420 kcal.
